introHtml: Large-size safety gear ensures a comfortable fit for employees who need extra room without sacrificing protection. Whether you are ordering high-visibility vests for construction crews or adjustable safety glasses for warehouse staff, large sizes accommodate a wider range of body types and face shapes. This reduces the chance of ill-fitting equipment that can compromise safety or comfort. Customize with your logo using screen printing or embroidery for a professional look that keeps your brand visible on the job site.
